listings.remarksConcat: Welcome to this exceptional single-family home, thoughtfully designed for modern living. You’ll also find a convenient ¾ bathroom, a bedroom/office, a walk-in pantry, and a mudroom off the garage for added functionality. This home is equipped with A/C, a 2-car garage, and is located in a lovely community.

listings.remarksConcat: Beautifully updated Bryant home offering privacy, high end improvements, and exceptional outdoor living. Originally a farmhouse, the home is set back from the street and surrounded by an established garden with perennial raised beds, mature fruit trees, and colorful seasonal plantings. Enjoy unobstructed Mt. Rainier views from the kitchen, dining room, and a bedroom. A sunny foyer welcomes you into the home, highlighted by a gorgeous wood accent ceiling that creates an instant wow factor. The light filled kitchen, living room, two bedrooms and first full bath complete the upstairs. Above the stairs, an insulated attic provides extensive additional storage space. Downstairs, the ensuite primary bedroom sits across from a flexible bonus room ideal for a nursery, office, den, guest room, or media space. A dedicated laundry room and mudroom round out the lower level. Extensive updates between 2020 and 2022 include a studs out remodel and new roof in 2020, wide plank French Oak hardwood floors and matching stairs, Miele appliances, LG ThinQ washer and dryer, and a 200 amp electrical service with new panel. Enjoy multiple outdoor spaces including low maintenance turf, a sunny deck, and rooftop terrace perfect for entertaining or relaxing. A detached garage with a modern automatic door adds even more functionality. All of this just blocks from PCC and Bryant Park and minutes from Metropolitan Market, the Burke Gilman Trail, Seattle Children’s Hospital, and University Village.

listings.remarksConcat: Charming, turn-key Gatewood home offering an impressive 1,800 square feet of beautifully maintained living space, including a fully finished lower-level suite with exceptional flexibility for rental income, multigenerational living, or adaptable everyday use.     A covered front porch and brand-new front lawn welcome you into this 1924 craftsman home offering character and warmth. The main floor features 3 bedrooms, a full bath, an inviting living room with a striking mid-century brick focal-point fireplace, dining area, and full kitchen. Downstairs, the recently renovated lower level offers a separate entry, new kitchen and appliances, spacious living and dining areas, a generous bedroom, bathroom, flex room, and excellent storage. Outside, enjoy a private lower patio for relaxing, along with secure bike/gear storage. Fresh landscaping, new fencing, and low-maintenance hardscaping are just a few of the benefits of this well-maintained home. Just minutes to West Seattle, restaurants, and freeways.
